data.text: Baseline/randomization visit
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 (SoA Table 1)

data.text: Primary endpoint visit
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 (SoA Table 1)

data.text: DXA scan must be completed at or within 7 days after V2. If rescan is needed and performed outside the 7 days, this will not be a protocol deviation.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 (SoA Table 1) - DXA scan row

data.text: At baseline, collect diary from participants who were not eligible for randomization (screen failed).
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 (SoA Table 1) - Return daily eDiary row

data.text: Optional; perform as needed to confirm postmenopausal status in individuals AFAB.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 (SoA Table 1) - FSH row

data.text: For details about the transition of participants from Study Period 1 to Study Period 2, see the schema (Section 1.2) and the relevant notes in the SoA for Study Period 2 (Section 1.3.2).
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 (SoA Table 1)

data.text: In addition to the fasting visits for lipids testing, site personnel can make fasting recommendations per local guidelines for the procedures.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 (SoA Table 1) - Laboratory tests section

data.text: AE collection should occur prior to the collection of the C-SSRS. Adapted for the assessment of ideation and behavior categories only.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 (SoA Table 1) - C-SSRS row

data.text: The daily eDiary will be applicable only to Study Period 1 and ED, if ED occurs in Study Period 1.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 (SoA Table 1) - Participant daily diary row

data.text: Site personnel must ensure the participant is trained on daily eDiary completion before the endoscopy visits. Provide additional training as needed.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 (SoA Table 1) - Daily eDiary training row

data.text: Site personnel must fully explain and confirm participant understanding of questionnaire before the device is provided to collect response.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 (SoA Table 1) - Dispense daily eDiary row

data.text: Participants who had a TST will return 48 to 72 hours after placement to have their test results read. PPD test does not need to be read at the site but must be read by a trained medical professional, and the result must be presented to the site personnel prior to participant's randomization.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 (SoA Table 1) - Tuberculosis Test row

data.text: The ICFs must be signed before any protocol-specific tests or procedures are performed.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 (SoA Table 1) - Complete informed consent row

data.text: The following confirmations are mandatory: meeting relevant inclusion and exclusion criteria before endoscopy and bowel preparation, and meeting all inclusion and exclusion criteria before randomization and administration of first dose of study intervention.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 (SoA Table 1) - Inclusion/exclusion criteria row

data.text: For details about the transition of participants from Study Period 1 to Study Period 2, see the schema (Section 1.2).
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Study Period 2 (SoA Table 2)

data.text: Participants who received LY/mirikizumab co-administration or mirikizumab in Study Period 1 and who are considered responders at Week 12 of Study Period 1 will receive mirikizumab SC starting at Week 0 of Study Period 2.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Study Period 2 (SoA Table 2)

data.text: For responders to mirikizumab or LY/mirikizumab co-administration treatment, Visit 6 and Visit 7 will occur on the same day and the Visit 6 procedures are not repeated at Visit 7 (excluding 'Register visit with IWRS').
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Study Period 2 (SoA Table 2)

data.text: Visit 8 and Visit 10 of the IIBD master protocol SoA do not apply to this ISA.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Study Period 2 (SoA Table 2)

data.text: V7 will be conducted on same day as V6
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Study Period 2 (SoA Table 2) - Visit detail row

data.text: Optional per investigator's discretion; perform as needed to confirm postmenopausal status in individuals AFAB.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Study Period 2 (SoA Table 2) - FSH row

data.text: Additional C. difficile testing is allowed throughout the study at the investigator's discretion.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Study Period 2 (SoA Table 2) - C. difficile testing row

data.text: Additional stool culture testing is allowed throughout the study at the investigator's discretion. Other local stool testing, for example, for ova and parasites, is allowed at the investigator's discretion.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Study Period 2 (SoA Table 2) - Stool culture row

data.text: Repeat injection training as needed.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Study Period 2 (SoA Table 2) - Injection training row

data.text: The timing for the safety follow-up will occur 8 weeks after the last dose of study drug.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Unscheduled Visits, Early Discontinuation, and Safety Follow-Up (SoA Table 3)

data.text: ECG needed at ED visit only if prior to Week 12.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Unscheduled Visits, Early Discontinuation, and Safety Follow-Up (SoA Table 3) - ECG row

data.text: At ED, the fistula evaluation is needed only when the ED is during Study Period 1.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Unscheduled Visits, Early Discontinuation, and Safety Follow-Up (SoA Table 3) - Fistula evaluation row

data.text: At ED, the CDAI assessment is needed only when the ED is during Study Period 1.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Unscheduled Visits, Early Discontinuation, and Safety Follow-Up (SoA Table 3) - CDAI row

data.text: At ED, the DXA scan is needed only when the ED is during Study Period 1.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Unscheduled Visits, Early Discontinuation, and Safety Follow-Up (SoA Table 3) - DXA scan row

data.text: Lipids (fasting) needed at ED visit only if prior to Week 12. Non-fasting lipids at ED will not be considered a protocol deviation, but fasting state should be recorded at time of collection.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Unscheduled Visits, Early Discontinuation, and Safety Follow-Up (SoA Table 3) - Lipids row

data.text: Optional per investigator's discretion; perform as needed to confirm postmenopausal status in individuals AFAB.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Unscheduled Visits, Early Discontinuation, and Safety Follow-Up (SoA Table 3) - FSH row

data.text: At ED, HBV DNA test is not required if done within the last 8 weeks.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Unscheduled Visits, Early Discontinuation, and Safety Follow-Up (SoA Table 3) - HBV DNA row

data.text: UACR needed at ED visit only if prior to Week 12.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Unscheduled Visits, Early Discontinuation, and Safety Follow-Up (SoA Table 3) - UACR row

data.text: IgG, IgA, IgM (quantitative immunoglobulins) needed at ED visit only if prior to Week 12.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Unscheduled Visits, Early Discontinuation, and Safety Follow-Up (SoA Table 3) - Immunoglobulins row

data.text: Calcium (urine) needed at ED visit only if prior to Week 12.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Unscheduled Visits, Early Discontinuation, and Safety Follow-Up (SoA Table 3) - Calcium row

data.text: Exploratory biomarkers (blood) needed at ED visit only if prior to Week 12.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Unscheduled Visits, Early Discontinuation, and Safety Follow-Up (SoA Table 3) - Exploratory biomarkers blood row

data.text: Exploratory biomarkers stool supernatant: Supernatant from the same stool sample used for fecal calprotectin testing. Needed at ED visit only if prior to Week 12.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Unscheduled Visits, Early Discontinuation, and Safety Follow-Up (SoA Table 3) - Exploratory biomarkers stool row
